text:
sanjay: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — tracking remediation owners for the canary blast-radius incident. I want a concise action list + owners + dates so we can close the loop. TL;DR: auto-rollback gating, tighter flag scopes, and a recurrence detector.

maria: thanks. can we get timelines? prefer owner + due date.

sanjay: posted draft below. initial items I propose:
- Ownership: @maria -> rollout policy doc + unit/integration tests (due 2026-04-07)
- @lex -> implement auto-rollback hooks in runtime + API (due 2026-04-10)
- @elaine -> telemetry + recurrence detector for canary regressions (due 2026-04-14)
- @kevin -> runbook + drill plan (due 2026-04-03)
I'll add these to the tracker and link GH issues. :white_check_mark:

lex: noted. q: auto-rollback should trigger on what signals? error-rate only or latency + error combos? :thinking: 

elaine: propose signals: sustained 5m error_rate > 3% OR p50 latency > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive 1m windows. Also flag rapid traffic skew to new variant (>60% within 5m). Those three together are good starting signals.

kevin: agreed. also want synthetic canary checks pre-rollout (smoke tests) to gate flag flips. I can wire them into CI.

maria: for flag scope, add a max_blast_radius default 10% traffic and require explicit approval for per-route overrides (owners must be listed).

sanjay: small policy matrix draft (please review):
```yaml
levels:
  - name: quick-rollback
    trigger: error_rate > 3% over 5m
    action: immediate_rollback
  - name: throttled-fallback
    trigger: latency > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive windows
    action: reduce_traffic_by_50%
  - name: staged-reduce
    trigger: traffic_skew_new_variant > 60% within 5m
    action: shift_traffic_to_stable
```
Comments?

lex: looks good. runtime API note: runtime should accept rollback_policy_id in the rollout API and return a rollback_token that can be used by control plane to call rollback. I'll file an API spec PR. :memo:

elaine: recurrence detector plan: run analytics over historical canary events and surface patterns like "midnight deploy regressions" or "model-version-specific spikes". Will emit weekly digest + signal when a pattern repeats 3x in 30 days. Need access to historical canary events/metrics.

kevin: runbook snippet to include in pages:
```
- on-alert:
  - notify: #oncall
  - check: canary_metrics.dashboard
  - check: latest-deploy.metadata
  - if rollback_condition: execute: /ops/rollback.sh --token ${rollback_token}
  - postmortem: create draft in GH template
```

tom: @sanjay can you own the single source tracking doc? happy to run the weekly drill once runbook is ready. :thumbsup:

sanjay: yes I'll own the tracker. action items: create GH issue board + link PRs + assign owners by EOD today. tagging owners now: @maria @lex @elaine @kevin @tom.

maria: confirming the dates above except I need lex to shift to 2026-04-10 (one extra week).

sanjay: updated. I created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/312 (tracker + checklist). I'll post the links in this thread and add weekly reminders. :bell:

oncall-bot: Reminder set: weekly drill on 2026-04-03 10:00 UTC assigned to tom.

kevin: added preliminary CI smoke tests to the PR linked in the tracker. testing infra still flaky but iterating. :wrench:

lex: filing runtime API spec now, will link. plan to start implementation next week.

elaine: pinging infra for access to historical canary metrics (cc @infra).

sanjay: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene in the weekly drill and close items as PRs land. if anyone hits blockers, drop them here. :eyes:
